suppliers.onboarding.title: New supplier
suppliers.onboarding.description: Link the supplier to an existing business party or create a new canonical business identity, then complete only procurement-specific information.
suppliers.onboarding.existingHelp: Name, contact details and tax identity remain managed by the business-party record. This action only adds the supplier role and procurement extension.
suppliers.onboarding.newHelp: This creates the canonical business-party record directly with the Supplier role. You will not need to enter this identity again elsewhere.
suppliers.onboarding.searchParty: Search by name, code, email or tax identifier…
suppliers.onboarding.noParty: No active business party matches this search.
suppliers.onboarding.identityDescription: These fields are the shared source of truth used by authorized modules.
suppliers.onboarding.contactDescription: Enter the primary details once; the supplier extension will reuse them.
suppliers.onboarding.procurementDescript: These fields belong to Procurement and do not change the shared business identity.
suppliers.onboarding.created: Supplier created and linked to the canonical business party.
suppliers.onboarding.loadFailed: Available business parties could not be loaded. Refresh and try again.
suppliers.onboarding.identityChoiceHelp: For an individual, any DTSC account remains linked to the person and never to a third-party organization.
